docs.title: ADR-0001: In-app DSP chain on Media3 AudioProcessors
docs.text: Status: Accepted (2026-11-18) · Deciders: project owner · Tags: audio, playback

docs.title: Context
docs.text:
The PRD (docs/prd/PRD-retro-player.md) asks for:

  • a 10-band graphic EQ at fixed frequencies 60, 170, 310, 600 Hz, 1, 3, 6, 12, 14 and 16 kHz, each ±12 dB in 1 dB steps, plus a preamp (R19);
  • a bypass that is bit-exact (R20);
  • bass boost and treble (R22), balance (R11) and no audible clipping (R23).

It must behave the same on every phone (G4). There is no code yet. Playback will use Media3 ExoPlayer (PRD R8).

android.media.audiofx.Equalizer exposes whatever bands the device's effect engine has, often 5 with OEM-chosen centres and gain ranges. It can only be attached to an audio session, and some OEMs disable it or apply it globally.

docs.title: A. Platform audiofx (Equalizer + BassBoost)
docs.text:
• How: attach to the ExoPlayer audio session id, then map the 10 UI bands onto the device bands by interpolation.
  • Cost: low.
  • Risk: the UI lies, because a "60 Hz" slider moves a "100 Hz" band. Band count and range vary by device, so R19's acceptance (+6 dB at 1 kHz ±1 dB) fails on many phones. Balance and limiting are not available.
  • Reversibility: easy.

docs.title: B. Custom AudioProcessors in ExoPlayer's DefaultAudioSink
docs.text:
• How: a chain of processors runs on decoded PCM:

    1. EqualizerProcessor: preamp, 10 RBJ peaking biquads (Q ≈ 1.41), a bass low-shelf at 100 Hz and a treble high-shelf at 10 kHz.
    2. BalanceProcessor: per-channel gain.
    3. LimiterProcessor: peak limiter at −0.1 dBFS.
    4. SpectrumTapProcessor: see ADR-0002.

    Processing is in float internally, with input and output in 16-bit PCM. The processors read an immutable DspConfig snapshot published by DspEngine through an AtomicReference, so the UI never blocks the audio thread.

  • Cost: medium, about 600 lines of pure Kotlin that are fully JVM unit-testable with synthetic sine waves. CPU for 13 biquads × 2 channels × 48 kHz is about 1.2 M multiply-adds per second, well under 1% of a modern core.

  • Risk: our own DSP bugs (mitigated by frequency-response tests). Audio only flows through the chain when PCM is decoded in-app: offload and passthrough must stay disabled, which is the ExoPlayer default.
  • Reversibility: moderate. The UI talks only to DspEngine, so the engine could swap to option A without touching screens.

docs.title: C. Native DSP (C++/Oboe, or a library such as SuperpoweredSDK)
docs.text:
• How: as B, but the processors run in native code.
  • Cost: high, with an NDK toolchain in CI and JNI.
  • Risk: licence terms (Superpowered is commercial), and native crashes.
  • Reversibility: hard.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text:
B. It is the only option that meets R19, R20, R22, R23 and R11 identically on every device, and it stays inside Kotlin and the JVM test suite that CI already runs. We give up the OEM effect engines (for example Dolby, which the user can still enable system-wide) and accept owning the DSP maths.

Processors accept and return C.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT. Float output (setEnableFloatOutput) is not enabled. How it interacts with audio processors has changed between ExoPlayer/Media3 versions, and 16-bit I/O with float math inside is enough for an EQ and limiter. A processor that receives any other encoding reports itself inactive, and the UI shows "DSP unavailable for this format" (spec B42).

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• New package com.canhamp.playback.dsp: Biquad, BiquadDesign, EqualizerProcessor, BalanceProcessor, LimiterProcessor, DspConfig, DspEngine.
  • PlayerFactory builds ExoPlayer with a custom RenderersFactory whose buildAudioSink adds the chain in that order.
  • Bypass (eqEnabled = false) makes EqualizerProcessor copy the input unchanged, which is a bit-exact null test (R20). Balance and the limiter still run.
  • Filter coefficients are recomputed only when the config or the sample rate changes, and filter state is reset in onFlush.
  • Tests: frequency response at every band centre, bypass null test, limiter ceiling with all bands at +12 dB, and a mono input path.
  • No new permission. No dependency beyond Media3.

docs.title: ADR-0002: Spectrum visualizer from an in-pipeline PCM tap
docs.text: Status: Accepted (2026-11-18) · Deciders: project owner · Tags: audio, permissions, ui

docs.title: Context
docs.text:
The main deck shows a 16-band spectrum analyser and a wave mode that move with the music (PRD R10). The PRD also says the app must not ask for the microphone (R10 acceptance: no RECORD_AUDIO in the manifest) and has no network (R30). ADR-0001 already puts our own AudioProcessor chain in ExoPlayer.

android.media.audiofx.Visualizer requires RECORD_AUDIO (a runtime "microphone" prompt). Its output is capped at 1024-sample captures, and it returns zeros on several OEM builds or when another effect is attached.

docs.title: A. Platform Visualizer on the player session
docs.text:
• Cost: low.
  • Risk: it forces the microphone permission and a scary prompt. It is unreliable across OEMs.
  • Reversibility: easy.

docs.title: B. SpectrumTapProcessor at the end of the DSP chain
docs.text:
• How: the last processor in the ADR-0001 chain:
    1. Pass-through copies the output PCM, downmixed to mono float, into a lock-free ring buffer of 4096 samples.
    2. A SpectrumAnalyzer coroutine on Dispatchers.Default wakes at most 30 times per second while the deck is visible. It takes the latest 1024 samples, applies a Hann window and a real FFT, then maps the bins to 16 log-spaced bands (50 Hz–16 kHz) in dB.
    3. It applies attack/decay smoothing and peak-hold, and emits a SpectrumFrame(bands: FloatArray, wave: FloatArray) through a StateFlow.
  • Cost: about 250 lines, unit-testable with sine inputs.
  • Risk: the bars run ahead of what is heard by the sink's buffer, typically 100–250 ms. Compensate by delaying frames by AudioTrack latency where the platform reports it (should).
  • Reversibility: easy.

docs.title: C. Fake animation (random bars, as in the Stitch HTML)
docs.text:
• Cost: none.
  • Risk: fails R10 ("bars move with the audio").

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: B. No permission, identical on all devices, and it reuses the ADR-0001 chain. We accept a small latency offset and a little CPU while the deck is visible. The analyser stops whenever no collector is active (WhileSubscribed), so there is no cost in the background.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Classes SpectrumTapProcessor, RingBuffer, Fft (radix-2, in-house, 1024 points) and SpectrumAnalyzer in com.canhamp.playback.dsp.
  • The UI collects DspEngine.spectrum with collectAsStateWithLifecycle, so collection stops when the screen is not visible.
  • The manifest has no RECORD_AUDIO or MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS. A CI check asserts this (spec B71).
  • Tests: a 1 kHz sine peaks in the band that contains 1 kHz, silence gives all bands at the floor, and the band edges are monotonic.

docs.title: ADR-0003: Room for library, queue and presets; DataStore for settings
docs.text: Status: Accepted (2026-11-18) · Deciders: project owner · Tags: data

docs.title: Context
docs.text:
The app keeps four kinds of local state:

  • a library index of a few thousand tracks, searchable and grouped by folder, artist and album (R1, R3, R4);
  • the play queue and position, which must survive a process kill (R17);
  • user EQ presets (R21);
  • scalar settings: theme, shuffle, repeat, EQ bands, balance and similar (R12, R20, R24).

The reference repo D:\DO\android already uses Room 2.6.1 with KSP (gradle/libs.versions.toml, roomVersion). The app has no server, and nothing leaves the device (R30).

docs.title: A. Room for collections, Preferences DataStore for scalars
docs.text:
• How: Room holds tracks, saf_folders, queue_items and eq_presets, with schema export and versioned migrations. DataStore holds settings as typed keys.
  • Cost: low. This is the known stack from the reference repo.
  • Risk: two stores, so code has to know which holds what. The split rule is "lists in Room, single values in DataStore".
  • Reversibility: moderate. The schema is versioned, and migrations are tested.

docs.title: B. Everything in Room (settings as a key-value table)
docs.text:
• Cost: low.
  • Risk: you lose DataStore's Flow-first typed API for settings and write more boilerplate.

docs.title: C. Re-query MediaStore every time, keep no index
docs.text:
• Cost: lowest.
  • Risk: cannot hold SAF-imported folders (R5) or cached bitrate and sample rate. Grouping and search become slow at about 2,000 tracks (G2), and the queue still needs storage.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: A. It is the reference repo's stack, it fits each data shape, and G2 needs an index. We give up a single store.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Dependencies: androidx.room (runtime, ktx, compiler via KSP) and androidx.datastore:datastore-preferences, both from the version catalog.
  • CanhAmpDatabase version 1, exportSchema = true, schemas in app/schemas/. Every later change ships a Migration plus a migration test. Never use fallbackToDestructiveMigration, because it would wipe user presets.
  • The library index is a cache: it can be rebuilt by Rescan, so a failed migration of tracks may clear and rescan. That fallback is allowed only for tracks.
  • Personal data (file names, titles) stays in app-private storage. Android Auto Backup stays on with default rules, so settings, presets and the queue come back on a new phone. The tracks index may be stale after a restore, and the first scan revalidates it (spec B5).

docs.title: ADR-0004: App id, SDK levels and CI signing for test builds
docs.text: Status: Accepted (2026-11-18) · Deciders: project owner · Tags: build, release, security

docs.title: Context
docs.text:
The owner named the app Canh Amp (PRD Q1) and will test by installing the APK that CI builds on every push to main (PRD Q4, R29). The CI is copied from D:\DO\android/.github/workflows/build.yml and release.yml:

  • JDK 24 Temurin;
  • testDebugUnitTest;
  • a lint translation check;
  • release signing from KEYSTORE_BASE64 / KEYSTORE_PASSWORD / KEY_ALIAS / KEY_PASSWORD secrets (app/build.gradle.kts of the reference repo, signingConfigs block).

The application id and the signing key cannot change after users install the app without forcing an uninstall. A debug APK built on a fresh CI runner is signed with that runner's random debug key. Each new build therefore has a different signature, so installing it over the previous one fails ("App not installed"), and uninstalling deletes the owner's queue, presets and settings.

docs.title: A. Fixed id; per-push APK = debug build signed with a stable debug key from a secret
docs.text:
• How: applicationId = "com.canhamp", minSdk 26, target and compile SDK 35.
    • build.yml decodes DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64 and signs assembleDebug with it, then uploads canh-amp-<shortsha>.apk as an artifact kept 14 days.
    • release.yml stays as in the reference repo, with the release key.
    • Debug builds use applicationIdSuffix = ".debug", so a test build and a release can sit side by side.
  • Cost: two keystores to create once.
  • Risk: a leaked debug key only lets someone overwrite the debug variant.

docs.title: B. Per-push APK = release build signed with the release key
docs.text:
• Cost: one keystore.
  • Risk: every push exposes the release key to more workflow runs. R8 minified builds are harder to debug, and builds are slower.

docs.title: C. Unsigned or per-runner debug key
docs.text:
• Cost: none.
  • Risk: every install needs an uninstall, so data is lost and testing becomes painful.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text:
A. Stable, upgradeable test installs without widening the use of the release key. If DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64 is missing (forks, first run), the workflow still builds with the runner key and prints a warning in the job summary.

versionCode comes from GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER in CI (falling back to 1 locally), so each push installs as an upgrade. versionName is 0.1.0-dev+<shortsha> on push and the dispatched version on release.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Owner one-time setup: create debug.jks and release.jks locally (never committed, because .gitignore blocks *.jks), base64 them into GitHub secrets DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64, DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEYSTORE_BASE64, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS and KEY_PASSWORD.
  • Workflows use permissions: contents: read (build) and contents: write (release only), as in the reference repo.
  • Branch is main (PRD Q5). The reference repo's master triggers are changed.
  • Changing com.canhamp later requires a new app listing and a user reinstall. Treat it as fixed.

docs.title: ADR-0005: Docs site with MkDocs Material on GitHub Pages
docs.text: Status: Accepted (2026-11-23) · Deciders: project owner · Tags: docs, ci, dependencies

docs.title: Context
docs.text: The PRD, specs, ADRs and plans live in docs/ as Markdown. The owner wanted the same published docs site as the sibling assessment repo: MkDocs Material, a hook that reads GitHub-style lists, Mermaid diagrams with zoom, and a workflow that deploys on every docs push. This adds a Python toolchain to an Android repo and a third-party script that every docs visitor's browser fetches.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text:
• Toolchain: MkDocs Material, pinned in docs/requirements.txt. CI installs from that file; the pip cache is keyed on its hash. Bump it deliberately, as with any dependency.
  • Publish: .github/workflows/docs.yml builds, fails on lists rendered as paragraphs (scripts/check-docs-lists.py), then runs mkdocs gh-deploy to the gh-pages branch. Pages serves that branch at https://nguyenhuuca.github.io/canh-amp/. The job needs contents: write to push gh-pages.
  • Mermaid from a CDN: pages load mermaid.min.js from unpkg.com at an exact version (mkdocs.yml, extra_javascript).
    • Egress: the visitor's browser requests the script from unpkg. No data from the app or the repo is sent; unpkg sees the visitor's IP and the docs page as referrer.
    • The owner approved this third-party fetch on 2026-11-23 (architecture review of the docs site).

docs.title: Options Considered
docs.text:
• Vendor mermaid.min.js into docs/javascripts/: no egress and no CDN trust, but about 3 MB in git history per version bump. Rejected for now; revisit if the docs ever hold private content or unpkg becomes unreliable.
  • No docs site, read Markdown on GitHub: zero tooling, but no search, no nav and no diagram zoom.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• The docs are public, like the repo. Nothing private belongs in docs/.
  • A Mermaid upgrade is an edit of one version string in mkdocs.yml.
  • Docs-only pushes also run build.yml, which has no path filter; harmless, a few CI minutes.

docs.title: Design system "Titanium Deck" (summary)
docs.text:
• Mode: dark only. Zero corner radius per the design doc (the HTML uses 4 dp radius; the PNGs win).
  • Colors: surface #101417, container-lowest #0B0F11, container #1C2023, container-high #262A2D, container-highest #313538, on-surface #E0E3E7, on-surface-variant #B9CCB2, outline #84967E. Phosphor green #00FF41 (primary-container), amber #FECB00 / #F1C100 (secondary), orange #FF8800 (clip), error #FFB4AB / #93000A.
  • Type: Space Mono for display, labels and numbers (uppercase labels, wide tracking); Space Grotesk for body text. Scale: display 26/30, title 14/18, body 13/18, label 12, 10 and 9 sp.
  • Spacing: 4 dp grid; 12 dp screen margin, 8 dp gutter.
  • Depth: recessed wells (inner shadow) for displays, raised plates for modules, pressed state = inverted gradient + 1 dp shift.
  • Touch: visuals can be 32x24 dp, but hit areas stay at 48 dp or more.
  • Shell: top header, then a mini-player bar above the bottom navigation (MAIN · EQ · PLAYLIST · LIBRARY [· SKINS]).

docs.title: PRD: Retro rack-mount MP3 player for Android
docs.text:
Status: Approved (2026-11-18) · Owner: project owner · Date: 2026-11-18 · PR-FAQ: n/a (single-owner app; owner chose to go straight to PRD)

App name: Canh Amp, package com.canhamp (Q1). The design is in docs/design/stitch/ (5 screens + the "Titanium Deck" design system).

docs.title: Problem
docs.text:
The owner has designed a skinnable late-90s audio deck UI in Stitch (phosphor-green VFD display, 10-band EQ, terminal-style playlist, local file library) and wants it as a real Android app that plays music stored on the phone. Stock and mainstream players (Google Files, Samsung Music, Spotify-style UIs) are flat Material designs, have no real 10-band graphic EQ and are built around streaming, not local MP3 folders. Today the owner uses one of those players and gets neither the look nor the EQ control.

Evidence: the five Stitch screens (docs/design/stitch/01..05-*.png) and the owner's request. No user research beyond that, so this is an app the owner builds for themself, with the option of sharing APKs later.

docs.title: Goals and Non-Goals
docs.text:
Goal Measure Target G1 Plays the local library reliably Playback keeps going with the screen off and app in background 60 min without stopping, on a device with Android 14+ G2 Library is usable at real size Time from "Rescan" to a populated list ≤ 5 s for 2,000 tracks on a mid-range phone G3 Looks like the design Owner review, each screen side by side with its Stitch PNG All 5 screens accepted, no layout breaking at 360–430 dp widths G4 EQ audibly works Changing a band or preset changes the output; bypass restores it Verified per band with a test tone (see R9) G5 Ships through CI like the reference repo build.yml green on every push; release.yml produces a signed APK First tagged release v0.1.0 G6 Feels responsive Cold start to interactive main screen ≤ 1.5 s on a mid-range phone (release build)

Not in scope (v1):

  • Importing real .wsz / .wal skin files. Skins are 4 built-in themes.
  • A-B loop, editing ID3 tags, setting a ringtone, Auto-EQ, 3D spatial / virtualizer.
  • Streaming, internet radio, "WINAMP NET", user accounts (the avatar in the header), cloud sync.
  • Google Play Store publishing (GitHub Release APKs only).
  • Tablet/foldable dual-chassis layout (phone portrait only; landscape must not crash).
  • Any "Winamp", "Nullsoft" or "Llama" names, slogans or logos (see R13).

docs.title: Users and Stories
docs.text:
• As a listener with MP3s on my phone, I want the app to find my music by itself so that I do not have to add files one by one.
  • As a listener, I want playback to continue with the screen off and controls on the lock screen and in the notification.
  • As a tinkerer, I want a real 10-band EQ with presets and my own saved curves so that I can shape the sound per song type.
  • As a playlist builder, I want to queue, reorder, remove, sort and save tracks as M3U so that I can reuse them in other players.
  • As a fan of retro hardware, I want the deck look (VFD display, spectrum bars, marquee, tactile buttons) and a few colour themes.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: Priorities: must = v1 cannot ship without it; should = in v1 unless it slips; could = only if cheap.

docs.title: Library (screen 5)
docs.text: ID Requirement Priority Acceptance R1 Scan device audio through MediaStore after the user grants READ_MEDIA_AUDIO (API 33+) or READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (API 26–32). Show each track with title, artist, album, format, bitrate, sample rate, size and duration. must Given 50 audio files on the device and permission granted, when the Library opens, then all 50 appear with correct format and duration, and the header shows the indexed count. R2 Permission denied state: explain why and offer a retry / settings link. The app must not crash. must Given permission is denied, when Library opens, then a rationale panel with a "Grant" button is shown and no list query runs. R3 Tabs: All tracks, Folders, Artists, Albums, Recent (by date added). must (All, Folders, Artists, Albums); should (Recent) Given tracks in 3 folders, when the user opens Folders and taps one, then only that folder's tracks appear with a breadcrumb path. R4 Search across title, artist, album and file name, as the user types. must Given "prodigy" is typed, when the list filters, then only tracks matching in any of those fields remain, case-insensitively. R5 Rescan button and "Import folder" via the Storage Access Framework (folder picker, permission persisted) for folders MediaStore misses. must (Rescan); should (Import folder) Given a SAF folder was imported, when the app restarts, then its tracks are still listed without asking again. R6 Per-track actions: Play now, Add to queue, Play next, Track details (read-only tags and stream info). must Given a track's ⋮ menu, when "Play next" is chosen, then that track plays right after the current one. R7 Storage usage bar (used / free) as in the design. could Given the screen is open, then the bar matches the values reported by StatFs within 1%.

docs.title: Playback and main deck (screen 1)
docs.text: ID Requirement Priority Acceptance R8 Playback via Media3 ExoPlayer inside a MediaSessionService: play, pause, stop, previous, next, seek. Includes a media notification, lock-screen controls, headset and Bluetooth buttons, audio focus (pause on call, duck on notification) and pausing when headphones are unplugged. Supported formats: whatever ExoPlayer decodes natively (MP3, AAC, FLAC, OGG/Opus, WAV). must Given a track is playing, when the screen is turned off for 60 min, then playback continues; when wired headphones are unplugged, then playback pauses within 1 s. R9 Main deck display: big elapsed/remaining timer (tap to toggle), track number, kbps and kHz, stereo/mono indicator, scrolling marquee with "artist - title (duration)". must Given a 320 kbps / 44.1 kHz stereo MP3, when it plays, then the deck shows "320", "44.1" and STEREO, and tapping the timer switches to a negative remaining time. R10 Spectrum visualizer with 16 bands from the real audio output, plus a BAR / WAVE mode switch. It must not need the microphone (RECORD_AUDIO) permission (see ADR need A2). must (BAR); should (WAVE); could (FIRE) Given music plays, then the bars move with the audio and stop when paused; the app manifest has no RECORD_AUDIO. R11 Seek bar, volume slider (app-level gain, 0–100%) and balance slider (L–C–R with a centre detent). must (seek, volume); should (balance) Given balance is moved fully left, when playing, then the right channel is silent. R12 Shuffle and repeat toggles (off / all / one) with LED states; they persist across restarts. must Given shuffle is on and the app is killed, when it restarts, then shuffle is still on. R13 No third-party trademarks: app name, header, footer "serial" plates, marquee filler and logo use the app's own name and assets. The visual style stays. must Given a text search of the APK resources for "winamp", "nullsoft" or "llama", then there are no matches. R14 Album art from embedded tags in the "now playing" card, with a styled placeholder when missing. should Given a file without embedded art, then the placeholder renders and no network request is made.

docs.title: Playlist / queue (screen 4)
docs.text: ID Requirement Priority Acceptance R15 Queue list in terminal style: index, title, bitrate badge, duration; playing row in inverted green, selected row in amber. Header stats: track count, total time, selected track time. must Given 18 tracks queued, then the header shows 18 and the sum of their durations. R16 Queue editing: tap to play, remove (× and DEL), reorder by drag, +FILE and +DIR (from the library or the folder picker), sort A–Z / by time, shuffle the queue, filter. must (play, remove, add, filter); should (drag reorder, sort) Given a track is dragged from position 5 to 2, when playback reaches position 2, then that track plays. R17 The queue and the current position persist across app restarts. must Given track 3 at 1:20 when the app is killed, when it relaunches, then track 3 is loaded at 1:20, paused. R18 Save the queue as .m3u8 and load .m3u / .m3u8 through the system file picker. Relative paths resolve against the playlist's folder; missing entries are skipped and counted. must Given a saved M3U8 is loaded in another player, then the same tracks appear in order. Given an M3U with 2 missing files, when loaded, then a message says "2 entries not found".

docs.title: Equalizer and effects (screen 2)
docs.text: ID Requirement Priority Acceptance R19 10-band graphic EQ at 60, 170, 310, 600 Hz, 1, 3, 6, 12, 14, 16 kHz, each −12…+12 dB in 1 dB steps, plus a preamp. Applied in the app's own audio pipeline, so it works the same on every device (see ADR need A1). must Given a 1 kHz test tone, when the 1K band goes to +6 dB, then the output level rises by 6 dB ±1 dB; other bands change it by less than 1 dB. R20 EQ on / bypass toggle; curve graph that redraws as bands move. must Given bypass, then the output equals the input (null test) and the curve is drawn flat and grey. R21 Presets: Rock, Pop, Techno, Flat, Full Bass, Club, Reggae, Vocal (values from the design HTML), user presets with save and delete, Reset flat. The active preset name shows "[CUSTOM]" after manual edits. must Given "Rock" is chosen and then the 60 Hz band is moved, then the label shows [CUSTOM]; given "Save preset" with a name, then it appears in the preset list after a restart. R22 Bass boost (0–12 dB low shelf) and treble (0–12 dB high shelf) knobs. should Given bass boost at +6, then a 60 Hz tone is 6 dB ±1 louder. R23 Output protection: when the EQ gain could clip, apply a limiter or automatic preamp drop so nothing clips audibly. must Given all bands at +12 dB on a 0 dBFS track, then the output has no samples clipping above 0 dBFS.

docs.title: Themes (screen 3) and shell
docs.text: ID Requirement Priority Acceptance R24 Four built-in themes from the design: Classic (green/amber), Modern "Bento" (slate/amber), Titanium Black (OLED black/red), Cyber Neon Matrix. Apply instantly and persist. Cards show a live mini preview, palette swatches and Apply / Applied. must Given "Titanium Black" is applied, when the app restarts, then all screens use its palette. R25 Theme options: "Preserve custom EQ colours" and "Allow animated visualizer" toggles. Pixel-scaling option omitted. could Given the animated visualizer is off, then the bars are drawn static at peak-hold. R26 App shell: header with app name and screen name, a persistent mini-player bar (title, elapsed time, prev / play-pause / next) and bottom navigation MAIN · EQ · PLAYLIST · LIBRARY · SKINS. The fake status row (clock, "network", "POWER ON") is dropped because Android already shows a status bar. must Given any screen, when the mini-player play/pause is tapped, then playback toggles and the main deck reflects it. R27 Design fidelity: the Titanium Deck tokens (colours, Space Mono / Space Grotesk bundled as OFL fonts, 4 dp grid, recessed/raised depth, pressed states) live in one Compose theme; touch targets are at least 48 dp; TalkBack labels on every control. must Given the Accessibility Scanner runs on each screen, then there are no touch-target or missing-label findings. R28 Strings in English and Vietnamese, checked in CI like the reference repo. must Given a string is added only to values/, when CI runs, then the translation check fails.

docs.title: Delivery
docs.text: ID Requirement Priority Acceptance R29 Stack and CI copied from D:\DO\android: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Gradle version catalog, minSdk 26, target/compile SDK 35, JDK 24 runner, default branch main. build.yml (on push/PR to main: unit tests, lint translation check, then build the APK and upload it as a workflow artifact so the owner can install and test it) and release.yml (manual dispatch: tests, signed APK from secrets, tag, changelog, GitHub Release). must Given a push to main, then build.yml passes and the run has a downloadable canh-amp-<sha>.apk artifact that installs on the owner's phone; given a release is dispatched with 0.1.0, then a release v0.1.0 with a signed APK appears. R30 No network permission and no analytics or telemetry. must Given the merged manifest, then android.permission.INTERNET is absent.

docs.title: Constraints and Risks
docs.text:
Risk Impact Mitigation Trademark. The mockups use Winamp/Nullsoft names, slogan and logo. Takedown or legal claim if shared. R13: own name and assets; CI check greps resources for the banned words. The Android Equalizer effect is device-dependent (often 5 bands at fixed frequencies). It cannot honour 10 fixed bands. EQ would not match the design. A1: 10 biquad peaking filters in a custom Media3 AudioProcessor (pure Kotlin, unit-testable on the JVM). Measure CPU cost; cap at 48 kHz stereo float. The Visualizer API needs RECORD_AUDIO, which scares users, and is unreliable on some OEMs. Permission prompt or a dead visualizer. A2: tap PCM after the EQ with an AudioProcessor, run an FFT on a background thread at about 30 fps, and expose the bands as a StateFlow. Android 14+ foreground service rules (mediaPlayback type) and OEM battery killers. Playback stops in background (G1). Use Media3 MediaSessionService with the correct service type; test on one Samsung/Xiaomi-class device. Scoped storage: MediaStore misses some folders; SAF URIs are slow to query. Missing tracks. Rescan plus SAF import (R5); index SAF folders into Room once and refresh on demand. Heavy skeuomorphic UI (gradients, glows, marquee, 30 fps bars) costs battery and frame drops. Jank, battery drain. Draw the visualizer in one Canvas; stop animations when the app is not visible; check with a Macrobenchmark or the JankStats baseline. Fonts licensing. Legal. Space Mono and Space Grotesk are SIL OFL: bundle them with the licence file. Signing keys. Leaked key. Same approach as the reference repo: keystore base64 and passwords only in GitHub secrets, never in the repo (security.md).

ADR needs implied by this PRD (write during /spec):

  • A1 Audio DSP pipeline: custom Media3 AudioProcessor chain (EQ → bass/treble → balance/gain → limiter → tap) instead of android.media.audiofx.
  • A2 Visualizer source: PCM tap + FFT instead of Visualizer + RECORD_AUDIO.
  • A3 Persistence: Room for the library index, queue and user presets; DataStore for settings and theme.
  • A4 App id com.canhamp, min SDK 26 / target SDK 35: hard to change after the first release.

docs.title: 1. Play a track from the Library (main path)
docs.text:
The user taps Play on a library row. The queue is replaced and playback starts with the DSP chain, the notification and the deck updates (B11, B20, B24).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant LS as LibraryScreen
    participant LVM as LibraryViewModel
    participant PC as PlayerConnection (MediaController)
    participant SVC as CanhAmpPlaybackService
    participant EXO as ExoPlayer
    participant DSP as DSP chain (Equalizer→Balance→Limiter→SpectrumTap)
    participant QR as QueueRepository
    participant DB as Room (queue_items)
    participant MS as MainScreen / MiniPlayerBar

    U->>LS: tap ▶ on row i
    LS->>LVM: playNow(trackId)
    LVM->>LVM: build items = visible list window (≤500), start = i
    LVM->>PC: setQueue(items, start) + play()
    PC->>SVC: MediaSession setMediaItems / play
    SVC->>EXO: setMediaItems(items, start, 0), then prepare(), then play()
    EXO->>EXO: request audio focus (USAGE_MEDIA)
    EXO->>DSP: 16-bit PCM buffers
    DSP-->>EXO: processed PCM (limited ≤ -0.1 dBFS)
    SVC-->>U: media notification (foreground, mediaPlayback)
    EXO-->>SVC: onTimelineChanged / onMediaItemTransition
    SVC->>QR: mirror(items) (debounced 500 ms)
    QR->>DB: REPLACE queue_items in one txn
    EXO-->>PC: onTracksChanged(Format: bitrate, sampleRate, channels)
    PC-->>MS: NowPlaying(item, isPlaying=true, kbps, kHz, STEREO)
    MS-->>U: timer, marquee, LEDs, mini player update

docs.title: 2. App start: restore the queue, position and modes
docs.text:
The service is created when the UI connects. It restores the last session, paused (B31, B56, B57).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant MA as MainActivity
    participant PC as PlayerConnection
    participant SVC as CanhAmpPlaybackService
    participant SET as SettingsRepository (DataStore)
    participant QR as QueueRepository
    participant DB as Room (queue_items)
    participant DE as DspEngine
    participant EXO as ExoPlayer

    MA->>PC: connect() (SessionToken)
    PC->>SVC: bind → onCreate()
    SVC->>SET: first(settings)
    SET-->>SVC: shuffle, repeat, volume, balance, eq*, queueIndex, queuePositionMs
    SVC->>DE: update(config from settings)
    SVC->>QR: load()
    QR->>DB: SELECT * FROM queue_items ORDER BY position
    DB-->>QR: rows
    QR-->>SVC: QueueSnapshot(items)
    SVC->>EXO: setMediaItems(items, queueIndex, queuePositionMs), then prepare()
    SVC->>EXO: shuffleModeEnabled, repeatMode, volume
    Note over EXO: stays paused (playWhenReady=false)
    SVC-->>PC: session connected
    PC-->>MA: NowPlaying(index, positionMs, isPlaying=false)
    Note over SVC,SET: while playing: savePosition every 10 s, on pause, on transition, onTaskRemoved

docs.title: 3. Library scan: permission denied, then granted
docs.text:
The first open of Library has no permission. The user grants it, and the scan fills the index (B1–B6).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant LS as LibraryScreen
    participant LVM as LibraryViewModel
    participant OS as Android permission UI
    participant LR as LibraryRepository
    participant MSS as MediaStoreScanner
    participant MSP as MediaStore provider
    participant DB as Room (tracks)
    participant SET as SettingsRepository

    LS->>LVM: onStart
    LVM->>LVM: check READ_MEDIA_AUDIO / READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
    LVM-->>LS: state = PermissionNeeded (rationale panel)
    U->>LS: tap GRANT
    LS->>OS: requestPermission
    alt denied
        OS-->>LS: denied
        LS-->>U: rationale stays, if permanently denied → button opens app settings
    else granted
        OS-->>LS: granted
        LS->>LVM: onPermissionGranted
        LVM->>LR: scan() (Mutex, joins a running scan)
        LR->>SET: read scanGeneration g
        LR->>MSS: query(projection, music & not ringtone/alarm, ≥10 s)
        MSS->>MSP: ContentResolver.query(Audio.Media)
        MSP-->>MSS: cursor
        loop per 500 rows
            MSS-->>LR: List<TrackEntity> (generation g+1)
            LR->>DB: UPSERT by uri (txn)
        end
        LR->>DB: DELETE MEDIASTORE rows WHERE scanGeneration ≤ g
        LR->>SET: scanGeneration = g+1
        LR-->>LVM: ScanResult(added, updated, removed, total)
        LVM-->>LS: paged list + "INDEXED: n" + storage bar
    end

docs.title: 4. EQ change: audio and visualizer update
docs.text:
The user moves the 1K band. The config is published lock-free, the audio thread picks it up at the next buffer, and the curve and spectrum reflect it (B43–B52, ADR-0001/0002).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant EQ as EqScreen
    participant EVM as EqViewModel
    participant DE as DspEngine
    participant EP as EqualizerProcessor (audio thread)
    participant LP as LimiterProcessor
    participant TAP as SpectrumTapProcessor
    participant SA as SpectrumAnalyzer (Default dispatcher)
    participant SET as SettingsRepository
    participant MS as MainScreen (SpectrumView)

    U->>EQ: drag 1K fader to +3
    EQ->>EVM: setBand(4, +3)
    EVM->>DE: update(gains[4] = 3, presetName = empty)
    DE->>DE: AtomicReference.set(DspConfig v+1), autoPreamp from analytic peak
    EVM-->>EQ: curve points (64), label [CUSTOM], GAIN x.x dB
    EVM->>SET: persist eqGains, eqPresetName (debounced 300 ms)
    Note over EP: next buffer (≤ 20 ms)
    EP->>DE: read config v+1
    EP->>EP: recompute coefficients (keep filter state)
    EP->>LP: filtered PCM (float)
    LP->>TAP: limited PCM 16-bit
    TAP->>TAP: copy mono samples → RingBuffer
    TAP-->>EP: pass-through to AudioTrack
    loop ≤ 30 fps while MainScreen is collecting
        SA->>TAP: read latest 1024 samples
        SA->>SA: Hann + FFT → 16 log bands, decay 18 dB/s
        SA-->>MS: StateFlow<SpectrumFrame>
    end

docs.title: 5. Load an M3U playlist with missing entries
docs.text:
The user loads a .m3u file. Entries resolve only through the library index; unresolved ones are counted (B65, B66, B76).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant PL as PlaylistScreen
    participant PVM as PlaylistViewModel
    participant SAF as System file picker
    participant PFR as PlaylistFileRepository
    participant CODEC as M3uCodec
    participant DB as Room (tracks)
    participant PC as PlayerConnection

    U->>PL: LIST >> → LOAD
    PL->>SAF: ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT (m3u mime types)
    SAF-->>PL: uri
    PL->>PVM: load(uri)
    PVM->>PFR: load(uri)
    PFR->>PFR: size check (≤ 2 MB) else TooLarge
    PFR->>CODEC: decode(text, baseDir from document id)
    alt > 10,000 lines or a line > 4,096 chars
        CODEC-->>PFR: NotAPlaylist
        PFR-->>PVM: error
        PVM-->>PL: "NOT A VALID PLAYLIST"
    else ok
        CODEC-->>PFR: entries (content / absolute / relative→abs / http)
        loop each entry
            PFR->>DB: SELECT by uri or filePath (parameterised)
            DB-->>PFR: track or null (http → missing)
        end
        PFR-->>PVM: LoadResult(items, missing=m)
        PVM-->>PL: confirm "REPLACE QUEUE?" (if queue not empty)
        U->>PL: confirm
        PVM->>PC: setQueue(items, 0)
        PVM-->>PL: "LOADED n, MISSING m"
    end

docs.title: 6. Interruptions: phone call and headphones unplugged
docs.text:
Audio focus and becoming-noisy handling come from Media3 defaults configured in PlayerFactory (B21).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant SYS as Android audio system
    participant EXO as ExoPlayer
    participant SVC as CanhAmpPlaybackService
    participant QR as QueueRepository / Settings
    participant UI as MainScreen

    SYS-->>EXO: AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT (incoming call)
    EXO->>EXO: pause (playWhenReady kept, suppression=TRANSIENT_AUDIO_FOCUS_LOSS)
    EXO-->>SVC: onIsPlayingChanged(false)
    SVC->>QR: savePosition(index, ms)
    EXO-->>UI: isPlaying=false (bars fall to floor ≤ 500 ms)
    SYS-->>EXO: AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN (call ended)
    EXO->>EXO: resume
    EXO-->>UI: isPlaying=true
    SYS-->>EXO: ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY (headphones out)
    EXO->>EXO: pause (playWhenReady=false)
    EXO-->>SVC: onIsPlayingChanged(false)
    SVC->>QR: savePosition
    Note over SVC: notification stays, service may leave foreground after Media3 timeout

docs.title: 7. Import a folder through SAF (failure: empty folder)
docs.text:
The user imports a folder that MediaStore misses (B10).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant LS as LibraryScreen
    participant LVM as LibraryViewModel
    participant SAF as System folder picker
    participant LR as LibraryRepository
    participant SFS as SafFolderScanner
    participant TMR as TrackMetadataReader
    participant DB as Room (saf_folders, tracks)

    U->>LS: + IMPORT FOLDER
    LS->>SAF: ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE
    SAF-->>LS: treeUri
    LS->>LVM: importFolder(treeUri)
    LVM->>LR: importFolder(treeUri)
    LR->>DB: exists(treeUri)?
    alt already imported
        LR-->>LVM: AlreadyImported
    else new
        LR->>LR: takePersistableUriPermission(READ)
        LR->>SFS: walk(treeUri, depth ≤ 8, files ≤ 10,000, audio ext only)
        alt no audio files
            SFS-->>LR: []
            LR->>LR: releasePersistableUriPermission
            LR-->>LVM: Empty
            LVM-->>LS: "NO AUDIO IN FOLDER"
        else n files
            SFS-->>LR: documents
            LR->>DB: INSERT saf_folders, then INSERT tracks (name-derived metadata)
            LR-->>LVM: ImportResult(n)
            LVM-->>LS: list shows n new tracks
            par background, 4 in parallel
                LR->>TMR: read(tags, duration, bitrate)
                TMR-->>LR: metadata
                LR->>DB: UPDATE tracks
            end
        end
    end

docs.title: Design Spec: App shell and design system
docs.text: Status: Approved (2026-11-18) · Spec: docs/specs/spec-retro-player.md · Date: 2026-11-18

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Give every screen the same rack-mount chassis: a header plate, the scrolling module stack, the mini player and the 5-tab nav. The one action that matters most is controlling playback from anywhere (mini player).

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
Phone portrait, 360–430 dp wide; mockups docs/design/stitch/*.png at 390 dp. Top to bottom:

  1. System status bar (edge-to-edge, surface-container behind it). The fake status row from the mockup is dropped (PRD R26).
  2. DeckHeader, 56 dp: app mark (vector, phosphor), title CANH AMP (title-md, phosphor glow) over the screen subtitle (label-sm), and on the right the STEREO/MONO LED pill. The avatar is dropped (no accounts).
  3. Content: a vertical scroll of DeckModules, 12 dp side margins, 8 dp gaps.
  4. MiniPlayerBar, 44 dp, above the nav. Hidden while the queue is empty.
  5. DeckNavBar, 64 dp + gesture inset: MAIN, EQ, PLAYLIST, LIBRARY, SKINS. The active tab is recessed (surface-container-highest, inner shadow, phosphor text).

Landscape and tablets use the same single column, centred, max width 480 dp (PRD non-goal: dual chassis).

docs.title: Design tokens (ui.theme)
docs.text:
• Colours: named tokens from docs/design/stitch/README.md, as DeckColors. Theme palettes swap the values (spec B67).
  • Type: DeckTypography with Space Mono (display, title, labels; labels always uppercase) and Space Grotesk (body). Fonts are bundled in res/font with OFL.txt in assets/licenses/.
  • Shapes: 4 dp radius on modules and buttons, matching the PNGs (PRD Q3); LEDs are circles.
  • Depth primitives:
    • RecessedWell: surface-container-lowest with a top inner shadow 0 2 4 #000 @85%.
    • DeckModule: raised; 1 dp top/left highlight #4A525D, 1 dp bottom/right #0F1112.
    • TactileButton: vertical gradient #383E46→#202326. Pressed inverts the gradient, offsets content by 1 dp and adds a phosphor glow on the icon.
  • Glow: text glow for VfdText is done with Shadow(color = primary @ 60%, blurRadius = 6dp).

docs.title: States
docs.text: State What the user sees Empty (no queue) Mini player hidden; Main shows the idle marquee (spec B25) Loading (service connecting) Mini player and deck show --:-- and dimmed LEDs; there is no spinner Error (session not connected after 3 s) Deck message ERR: AUDIO ENGINE OFFLINE; reconnect retries every 2 s Populated Mini player shows [mm:ss] ARTIST - TITLE with prev / play-pause / next

docs.title: Interactions
docs.text:
• Tap a tab to switch, keeping per-tab scroll state. System back returns to MAIN; back on MAIN exits.
  • Mini player: tapping the text opens MAIN; the buttons act directly, with haptic KEYBOARD_TAP on press.
  • Decorative screws and serial plates are not focusable.

docs.title: Content (translation keys, EN / VI)
docs.text: Key EN VI app_name Canh Amp Canh Amp nav_main MAIN CHÍNH nav_eq EQ EQ nav_playlist PLAYLIST DANH SÁCH nav_library LIBRARY THƯ VIỆN nav_skins SKINS GIAO DIỆN led_stereo / led_mono STEREO / MONO STEREO / MONO err_engine_offline ERR: AUDIO ENGINE OFFLINE LỖI: MÁY PHÁT CHƯA SẴN SÀNG cd_play / cd_pause / cd_next / cd_previous Play / Pause / Next track / Previous track Phát / Tạm dừng / Bài tiếp / Bài trước

docs.title: Accessibility
docs.text:
• Every interactive element has a hit area of at least 48 dp (Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()), even when its visual is 28 dp.
  • Contrast: phosphor #00FF41 on #0B0F11 is about 13:1; dim labels #B9CCB2 on #1C2023 about 9:1. Theme palettes must keep body text at ≥ 4.5:1, which a unit test checks per palette.
  • TalkBack: the nav tabs are Role.Tab with a selected state; LED toggles use Role.Switch with a state description.
  • Reduced motion: when the animator scale is 0, the marquee, LED pulse and glow animation are static (spec B70).

docs.title: Design Spec: Graphic Equalizer
docs.text: Status: Approved (2026-11-18) · Spec: docs/specs/spec-retro-player.md · Date: 2026-11-18 · Mockup: docs/design/stitch/02-graphic-equalizer.png

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Shape the sound with 10 bands and presets. Most important action: pick a preset or move a band and hear the change.

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
1. EQ main unit:
    • Header plate: CANH AMP EQUALIZER / DSP PRO AUDIO RACK // MOD-10B, the power LED toggle (ON / BYPASS) and the PRESET button.
    • Curve well: > CURVE RESPONSE: [ROCK] and GAIN: x.x dB, then a 64 dp phosphor grid with the curve (B45).
    • Fader deck: a +12dB / 0dB (FLAT) / -12dB scale, then an 11-column grid: PRE (amber knob line) plus 60…16K. Each column is a VFader 144 dp tall with the value label below (+5, -1).
  2. Analog harmonic processor: BASS BOOST and TREBLE Knobs (0..12 dB, ring arc). The 3D SPATIAL card from the mockup is out of scope and replaced by a BALANCE mini fader that mirrors Main.
  3. Action row: RESET FLAT, SAVE PRESET, and a third button for the user presets list (MY PRESETS). The mockup's AUTO-EQ is out of scope.
  4. Footnote: CANH AMP DSP ENGINE v0.1 and STATUS: LOCKED {kHz}kHz (from NowPlaying.sampleRateHz).

Preset drawer: a bottom sheet in the module style with a 2-column grid of preset buttons (name + tag: CLASSIC, BASS+, 0dB…). The active preset has a green left border and ACTIVE; user presets are tagged USER, and a long press deletes one.

docs.title: States
docs.text: State What the user sees Default (first run) Flat preset, ON Bypass LED off, BYPASS; curve flat and grey; faders still movable (edits apply when turned on) DSP unsupported Pill DSP N/A FOR THIS STREAM; controls enabled but note shown (B42) Custom Label [CUSTOM] Save error Inline under the name field: NAME 1-24 CHARS, NAME IN USE BY BUILT-IN; or an overwrite confirm

docs.title: Interactions
docs.text:
• Fader drag snaps to 1 dB steps; double tap resets that band to 0. Haptic tick on every dB step and at 0.
  • Knob: vertical drag or rotation gesture; double tap resets to 0.
  • PRESET opens the drawer, and choosing a preset closes it (B46). SAVE PRESET opens a dialog with a text field, Save and Cancel (B48).

docs.title: Content (keys)
docs.text: Key EN VI eq_title CANH AMP EQUALIZER BỘ CÂN BẰNG CANH AMP eq_on / eq_bypass ON / BYPASS BẬT / BỎ QUA eq_preset / eq_custom PRESET / [CUSTOM] CÀI SẴN / [TÙY CHỈNH] eq_curve / eq_gain CURVE RESPONSE: / GAIN: ĐƯỜNG CONG: / ĐỘ LỢI: eq_reset / eq_save / eq_my_presets RESET FLAT / SAVE PRESET / MY PRESETS VỀ PHẲNG / LƯU / CỦA TÔI eq_bass / eq_treble BASS BOOST / TREBLE TĂNG BASS / TREBLE eq_name_invalid / eq_name_builtin / eq_overwrite NAME 1-24 CHARS / NAME IN USE BY BUILT-IN / OVERWRITE "%1$s"? TÊN 1-24 KÝ TỰ / TRÙNG TÊN CÓ SẴN / GHI ĐÈ "%1$s"? eq_dsp_na DSP N/A FOR THIS STREAM DSP KHÔNG HỖ TRỢ LUỒNG NÀY Preset names ROCK, POP, TECHNO, FLAT, FULL BASS, CLUB, REGGAE, VOCAL (same, not translated)

docs.title: Accessibility
docs.text:
• Each fader is a slider with a label "60 hertz" and a value "plus 5 decibels". Volume keys do not move EQ faders.
  • Faders are 24 dp wide visually; the 11-column grid at 360 dp gives about 29 dp per column, so each fader's touch area extends vertically to 144 dp and horizontally to the column width. TalkBack swipe up/down adjusts by 1 dB, which works around the narrow width.
  • The curve is decorative; the current preset name is announced on change.

docs.title: Design Spec: Local Library
docs.text: Status: Approved (2026-11-18) · Spec: docs/specs/spec-retro-player.md · Date: 2026-11-18 · Mockup: docs/design/stitch/05-local-library.png

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Find music on the phone and send it to the deck. Most important action: tap ▶ on a track.

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
1. Storage telemetry bay: the storage root label (/INTERNAL STORAGE/MUSIC) and RESCAN (sync icon, spins while scanning); a segmented capacity bar (audio / other used / free) with CAPACITY USED: x GB / y GB and z GB FREE; a footer INDEXED: n AUDIO STREAMS / SCANNING n and DATABASE: V1 OK.
  2. Search terminal: a recessed field with a terminal icon (QUERY: ARTIST / TITLE / FILE...) and backspace-clear.
  3. Tab rail (horizontal scroll): ALL TRACKS (n), FOLDERS, ARTISTS (n), ALBUMS (n), RECENT.
  4. Breadcrumb well (Folders drill-down only): /0/Music / Retro_Vault_98/ and n FILES; tapping a segment goes up.
  5. List: track cards (icon by format, title-md title, a badge row .MP3 · 320 KBPS · 44.1 KHZ · 9.4 MB, a second line ALBUM: … and MOD: date, then ▶ and ⋮ buttons at 32 dp visual / 48 dp hit). Group tabs show group cards (name, count, chevron).
  6. Sticky import bar: + IMPORT FOLDER / SCAN (primary green button) and SD MNT: …. Hidden in pick mode, where it becomes ADD n TO QUEUE.

Action sheet (⋮): the track title, then ADD TO QUEUE, PLAY NEXT and TRACK DETAILS & TAGS. The mockup's SET AS RINGTONE is out of scope.

Track details sheet: read-only rows for title, artist, album, year, genre, track number, format, bitrate, sample rate, channels, duration, size, path and date modified.

docs.title: States
docs.text: State What the user sees No permission Bay replaced by a rationale module: STORAGE ACCESS REQUIRED, an explanation, and GRANT ACCESS (or OPEN SETTINGS after a permanent denial) (B1) Scanning (first time) Bay shows SCANNING n; the list shows skeleton rows with a dim phosphor shimmer (static when animations are off) Empty (scanned, 0 tracks) NO AUDIO FOUND with a hint to import a folder Search no results NO MATCH FOR "x" Populated Paged list Pick mode (+FILE/+DIR from Playlist) Checkboxes on cards; the sticky bar reads ADD n TO QUEUE Import results Toasts: IMPORTED n TRACKS, NO AUDIO IN FOLDER, FOLDER ALREADY IMPORTED

docs.title: Interactions
docs.text:
• ▶ plays now (B11). Tapping a card body also plays now; ⋮ opens the sheet.
  • Tab switch keeps the search text, and the search applies within the tab.
  • RESCAN runs a scan (B6); the bar keeps working during it.
  • Imported SAF folders appear as Folders groups with a SAF badge. A long press offers REMOVE FOLDER (releases the grant, deletes its tracks after confirm).

docs.title: Accessibility
docs.text:
• A card is one focusable node ("Daft Punk, Around The World, MP3, 320 kilobits, 9.4 megabytes") with custom actions Play, Add to queue, Play next and Details.
  • The scan progress is announced on a polite live region at start and at the end only.
  • The permission rationale is read before the system dialog appears.

docs.title: Design Spec: Main Player (deck)
docs.text: Status: Approved (2026-11-18) · Spec: docs/specs/spec-retro-player.md · Date: 2026-11-18 · Mockup: docs/design/stitch/01-main-player.png

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: See what is playing and control it like a hardware deck. Most important action: play/pause.

docs.title: Layout (modules top to bottom, as in the mockup)
docs.text:
1. Chassis plate: screws, CHASSIS 2.91 // AMP-DEC, and a DSP READY / DSP BYPASS / DSP N/A pill from DspEngine.status.
  2. VFD display well:
    • Status row: CANH AMP and PRO V0.1, plus AUDIO ON when playing.
    • Grid of 12 columns:
      • left (5): track number, time mode label, 7-segment-style timer (display-lg-mobile, glow), KBPS and KHZ;
      • right (7): SPECTRUM RTA with the MODE: BAR|WAVE button, the 16-band SpectrumView and frequency labels 60 170 310 600 1K 3K 6K 12K 16K.
    • Marquee strip.
    • Four badges: BITRATE, SAMPLING, CHANNELS STEREO (lit), MONO (dim unless mono).
  3. Song position seek: a label with elapsed / duration, then an HFader with a ribbed thumb.
  4. ~~Volume | Balance~~ removed on owner request (2026-11-19) to shorten the screen. Volume uses the phone's volume keys; balance stays on the EQ screen.
  5. Transport deck: 6 TactileButtons in a row (PREV, PLAY, PAUSE, STOP, NEXT, OPEN). The active PLAY is recessed with a glow. A MOTOR RUNNING LED shows while playing.
  6. Toggles: SHUFFLE and REPEAT (OFF / ALL / ONE, label REPEAT, REPEAT ALL, REPEAT 1) LedToggles, plus a quick button that opens EQ. The mockup's A-B LOOP and ID3 TAG buttons are out of scope: ID3 TAG becomes INFO (track details sheet, read-only); A-B LOOP is omitted.
  7. Now-playing card: 64 dp artwork or the cassette placeholder; a format badge (for example MPEG-1 LAYER 3, FLAC), title (title-md) and artist • album (body-md).
  8. Footer plate: SERIAL NO: CA-2026-001 and CANH AMP.

docs.title: States
docs.text: State What the user sees Empty queue Timer --:--; bars at the floor; idle marquee; transport disabled except OPEN (goes to Library); card shows "NO TRACK LOADED" Loading (preparing) Timer frozen; BUFFERING replaces AUDIO ON Error (file unreadable) Marquee ERR: CANNOT READ FILE for 3 s, then auto-skip (B27) Paused PAUSE recessed; bars decay to the floor; motor LED off Playing PLAY recessed and glowing; bars live; marquee scrolling

docs.title: Interactions

docs.text: Status: Approved (2026-11-18) · PRD: docs/prd/PRD-retro-player.md · ADRs: 0001 DSP chain, 0002 visualizer tap, 0003 Room + DataStore, 0004 app id and CI signing · Date: 2026-11-18

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Canh Amp is a single-module Android app (:app, package com.canhamp), built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It plays local audio through Media3 ExoPlayer inside a MediaSessionService, with an in-app DSP chain (ADR-0001) and a PCM-tap visualizer (ADR-0002). It indexes music from MediaStore and SAF folders into Room (ADR-0003). The UI follows the Stitch "Titanium Deck" design across five screens: Main, EQ, Playlist, Library and Skins. It covers PRD R1–R30. The trace table at the end maps each requirement to behaviours (B-numbers) and sequence diagrams (docs/sequence/sequence-retro-player.md). Design specs: docs/specs/design-spec-*.md.

docs.title: Library: R1–R7
docs.text:
• B1 On first open of Library, if the permission is missing, show the rationale panel. Request the permission only when "Grant" is tapped. After a permanent denial, the button opens the app's system settings. (R2)
  • B2 A scan queries MediaStore.Audio.Media with IS_MUSIC != 0 (music only: no voice recordings, podcasts or audiobooks). It excludes ringtones, notifications and alarms (IS_RINGTONE, IS_NOTIFICATION, IS_ALARM = 0) and files shorter than 10 s. It runs in one cursor pass on Dispatchers.IO. (R1)

  • B3 Map each row to a tracks row:

    • format from the extension of DISPLAY_NAME (else from MIME_TYPE);
    • bitrateKbps from BITRATE on API 30+, else sizeBytes * 8 / durationMs rounded;
    • folderPath from RELATIVE_PATH (29+) or the parent of DATA;
    • filePath from DATA when it is readable.

    Empty title, artist or album fall back as in the data model. (R1)

  • B4 Upsert by uri in batches of 500 inside one transaction per batch, setting scanGeneration = current + 1. (G2)

  • B5 After a full MediaStore scan, delete source = MEDIASTORE rows with an older scanGeneration, then store the new generation in DataStore. SAF rows are refreshed per folder the same way (B10). This also repairs a stale index after a backup restore. (R1)
  • B6 A scan runs on app start if the last scan is older than 24 h or the permission was just granted, on Rescan, and after an import. Only one scan runs at a time (a Mutex): a second request while one runs joins the running one. (R5)
  • B7 Search: trim the query, cap it at 100 chars, debounce 150 ms, escape %, _ and \. Match with LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' on title, artist, album and fileName. SQLite LIKE is ASCII case-insensitive; Vietnamese diacritics must match as stored. Paging uses pages of 50. (R4)
  • B8 sampleRateHz is unknown from MediaStore. It is filled when (a) the track is played, from the ExoPlayer Format.sampleRate, or (b) Track details opens, from MediaMetadataRetriever (METADATA_KEY_SAMPLERATE on API 31+). The value is written back to the row. Lists show — while unknown. (R1, R9)

  • B9 Tabs:

    • All: title A–Z, case-insensitive.
    • Folders: groups by folderPath with counts; tapping a group shows its tracks and a breadcrumb.
    • Artists and Albums: grouped the same way.
    • Recent: dateAddedSec DESC, at most 100 rows.

    The counts in tab labels come from the same queries. (R3)

  • B10 Import folder: open ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE and call takePersistableUriPermission(READ).

    • Walk the tree with DocumentsContract children queries, breadth-first, at most 8 levels deep and 10,000 files, keeping supported extensions only.
    • Rows are inserted with file-name-derived metadata first. Then TrackMetadataReader fills tags, duration and bitrate on a background pass, with up to 4 files in parallel.
    • The same tree URI twice gives AlreadyImported. A folder with no audio gives Empty, and the grant is released.
    • On start, persisted grants that were lost (contentResolver.persistedUriPermissions) remove that folder and its tracks. (R5)

  • B11 Track actions:

    • Play now replaces the queue with the current list view (≤ 500 items around the tapped one) and starts at the tapped track.
    • Add to queue appends.
    • Play next inserts at currentIndex + 1.
    • Details shows the read-only TrackDetails sheet.

    Each action shows a short toast-style deck message. (R6)

  • B12 Storage bar: StatFs(Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory()) gives total and free. The audio share is the sum of tracks.sizeBytes. (R7)

  • B13 A track whose URI no longer opens (FileNotFoundException, SecurityException) is skipped by the player (B27) and removed from tracks on the next scan.
  • B14 The scan and import progress shows in the storage panel as "SCANNING n" and does not block browsing.

docs.title: Playback and main deck: R8–R14
docs.text:
• B20 CanhAmpPlaybackService extends MediaSessionService with foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback". It owns the single ExoPlayer built by PlayerFactory with:

    • setAudioAttributes(USAGE_MEDIA, CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC, handleAudioFocus = true);
    • setHandleAudioBecomingNoisy(true);
    • setWakeMode(C.WAKE_MODE_LOCAL);
    • the DSP chain from ADR-0001.

    Media3 provides the notification and lock-screen controls through DefaultMediaNotificationProvider. (R8)

  • B21 Audio focus: on a call (permanent or transient loss), pause, and resume on a transient gain. Duck on CAN_DUCK (Media3 default). Unplugging wired headphones or Bluetooth disconnecting pauses within 1 s. (R8)

  • B22 Transport:
    • Previous within 3 s of the start goes to the previous item; otherwise it restarts the current one.
    • Stop = pause + seek to 0 + keep the queue.
    • Next on the last item with repeat OFF stops at the end.
    • Open (eject) navigates to Library. (R8)
  • B23 Media buttons (headset single/double/triple press, Bluetooth AVRCP) are handled by MediaSession defaults. (R8)
  • B24 Deck display:
    • The timer shows mm:ss, or h:mm:ss for tracks of 1 h or more. Tapping toggles ELAPSED / REMAINING (shown as -mm:ss), and the choice persists.
    • kbps comes from Format.bitrate (or the tracks value). kHz shows one decimal.
    • STEREO lights when channelCount ≥ 2, otherwise MONO.
    • The track number is the 1-based queue index. (R9)
  • B25 The marquee text is "*** {index}. {artist} - {title} ({duration}) [{kbps}kbps {stereo|mono} {kHz}kHz] ***". It scrolls at 30 dp/s and pauses while the app is backgrounded. With an empty queue it shows *** CANH AMP *** LOAD A TRACK FROM THE LIBRARY ***. (R9, R13)
  • B26 Visualizer:
    • Collect DspEngine.spectrum only while the Main screen is resumed.
    • BAR mode draws 16 columns of 2 dp segments: the bottom 10 green, the next 4 amber, the top 2 orange, plus a peak-hold dot that decays at 12 dB/s.
    • WAVE mode draws the last 256 mono samples as a polyline.
    • When paused or stopped, the bars fall to the floor within 500 ms.
    • If visAnimated is off, nothing follows the music: BAR draws the unlit grid, WAVE a flat line, and the spectrum is not collected (the FFT does not run). Changed 2026-11-20: the peak dots used to keep moving. (R10, R25)
  • B27 If the current item fails to open or decode (PlaybackException), show ERR: CANNOT READ FILE in the marquee for 3 s and skip to the next item. After 5 failures in a row, stop. (R8)
  • B28 Seek bar drag: preview the time while dragging, and seek once on release. (R11)
  • B29 Volume: player.volume (0..1) maps linearly to 0..100%, in steps of 1%. The value persists. (R11)
  • B30 Balance −1..1 in steps of 0.05, with a snap to 0 when |b| < 0.05 (centre detent). BalanceProcessor multiplies left by min(1, 1 − b) and right by min(1, 1 + b), so −1 silences right and +1 silences left. Mono input is upmixed by the decoder as stereo. (R11)
  • B31 Shuffle and repeat map to player.shuffleModeEnabled and repeatMode (OFF, ALL, ONE cycle on tap). Both persist in DataStore and are restored before playback resumes. (R12)
  • B32 Now-playing card: embedded artwork from MediaMetadata.artworkData, decoded at 64 dp with inSampleSize. Otherwise show the placeholder cassette drawable. There is no network loading. (R14)
  • B33 Branding: strings, drawables and the launcher icon use "Canh Amp" only. Header plate: CANH AMP // MAIN PLAYER. Chassis plates: CHASSIS 2.91 // AMP-DEC (decorative; contains no trademark), footer SERIAL NO: CA-2026-001 and CANH AMP. (R13)

docs.title: Equalizer and DSP: R19–R23
docs.text:
• B40 Bands, in Hz: [60, 170, 310, 600, 1000, 3000, 6000, 12000, 14000, 16000]. Each is an RBJ peaking filter with Q = 1.41 and gain −12..12 dB, integer steps. A band whose centre is ≥ 0.45 × sample rate is skipped (for example 16 kHz at a 32 kHz rate). (R19)
  • B41 Preamp −12..12 dB is applied before the filters. Bass is a low-shelf at 100 Hz (S = 1), 0..12 dB; treble is a high-shelf at 10 kHz, 0..12 dB. (R19, R22)
  • B42 Processors handle 16-bit PCM, mono or stereo, at 8–96 kHz. For any other input format the chain reports UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT and passes audio through. The EQ screen then shows DSP N/A FOR THIS STREAM. (R19)
  • B43 Config changes: DspEngine.update publishes a new immutable DspConfig. Processors pick it up at the next buffer (≤ 20 ms). Coefficients are recomputed then. Filter state carries over, so slider moves do not click; changing the sample rate resets the state. (R19)
  • B44 Bypass (eqEnabled = false) skips preamp, bands, bass and treble, and copies the samples bit-exact. Balance, volume and the limiter still apply. The curve draws flat in outline colour, and the LED shows BYPASS. (R20)
  • B45 The curve graph is the analytic magnitude response of the current config (bands + preamp + shelves), sampled at 64 log points from 20 Hz to 20 kHz on a ±15 dB scale. It is drawn with a glow stroke and a gradient fill, and recomputes on every change. (R20)

  • B46 Presets: built-ins with the gains from the Stitch HTML (preamp 0):

    Preset Gains Rock 5,7,3,-1,-2,1,4,7,8,9 Pop -1,2,4,5,4,2,-1,-2,-2,-2 Techno 7,6,2,-3,-4,0,5,8,8,7 Flat 0×10 Full Bass 11,10,8,4,0,-2,-4,-6,-7,-8 Club 0,2,4,3,3,3,2,0,1,2 Reggae 0,1,-1,-4,-1,3,4,2,0,0 Vocal -3,-4,-2,4,7,6,3,1,-1,-3

    Choosing a preset sets the gains and preamp and writes eqPresetName. (R21)

  • B47 Any manual band or preamp change clears eqPresetName, and the label shows [CUSTOM]. Reset flat applies Flat. (R21)

  • B48 Save preset opens a name dialog.
    • Validation: trim; 1–24 chars; letters, digits, space, - and _ only.
    • It must not equal a built-in name (case-insensitive). If a user preset has the same name, ask "Overwrite?".
    • User presets show after the built-ins, marked USER, and can be deleted with a long press and confirm. (R21)
  • B49 Headroom: effective pre-gain = preamp − max(0, maxBoost), where maxBoost is the peak of the analytic response from B45 (bands + shelves) in dB. This "auto-preamp" keeps loudness steady and is shown as GAIN: x.x dB on the EQ screen. (R23)
  • B50 LimiterProcessor:
    • Peak limiter with a −0.1 dBFS ceiling, 0.5 ms attack and 80 ms release, linked across channels.
    • It runs in float after balance and converts back to 16-bit with clamping, so output never exceeds full scale. It runs even in bypass, and is transparent while the signal stays under the ceiling. (R23)
  • B51 Analyser: 1024-point FFT with a Hann window at ≤ 30 fps.
    • 16 log-spaced bands from 50 Hz to 16 kHz; each band's value is the max bin magnitude in dB, normalised over −60..0 dB to 0..1.
    • Smoothing: attack instant, decay 18 dB/s. (R10)
  • B52 All DSP and EQ settings persist in DataStore on change, debounced 300 ms, and are applied on service start before the first buffer. (R19–R22)

docs.title: Queue and playlists: R15–R18
docs.text:
• B55 The queue is the player's media item list. QueueRepository mirrors it to queue_items on every timeline change, replacing all rows in one transaction, debounced 500 ms, with up to 5,000 items. Adding beyond 5,000 rejects the excess and shows QUEUE FULL (5000). (R15, R17)
  • B56 Position is saved to DataStore every 10 s while playing, on pause, on item transition and in onTaskRemoved / onDestroy. (R17)
  • B57 Restore on service create: load queue_items, set the items, seek to queueIndex / queuePositionMs, and stay paused. Items whose URI is no longer readable stay listed, greyed with MISSING, and are skipped by B27. (R17)
  • B58 The header stats are the track count, the total duration (sum of durationMs, h:mm:ss) and the selected row's duration. They update with every queue change. (R15)
  • B59 Row states: playing = inverted green with a speaker icon; selected (last tapped, not playing) = amber; others default. A single tap selects; a double tap or the play icon plays. A long press starts a drag (reorderable); the drop calls player.moveMediaItem(from, to). (R15, R16)
  • B60 Remove: the row's × or DEL removes the selected row. Removing the playing item goes to the next one, or stops if it was the last. Remove shows an UNDO action for 4 s. (R16)
  • B61 +FILE opens Library in pick mode (multi-select, then "ADD n"). +DIR opens the Folders tab in pick mode (adds the whole folder, sorted by file name). (R16)
  • B62 SORT cycles title A–Z → artist A–Z → duration ascending, and is applied as one reorder that keeps the playing item playing. RND shuffles the queue order once; this differs from shuffle mode. The loop button cycles repeat (B31). (R16)
  • B63 The filter is local to the queue view: case-insensitive contains on title and artist. It does not change the queue. Clearing it restores the view. (R16)
  • B64 M3U save:
    • Use ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT with the default name canh-amp-YYYYMMDD-HHmm.m3u8 and MIME audio/x-mpegurl.
    • Write UTF-8 without BOM: #EXTM3U, then for each item #EXTINF:<seconds>,<artist> - <title> and a path line.
    • The path line is filePath when known, else the content URI. (R18)
  • B65 M3U load:
    • Use ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT (audio/x-mpegurl, audio/mpegurl, application/vnd.apple.mpegurl, text/plain).
    • Reject files over 2 MB, or with more than 10,000 lines or a line over 4,096 chars, as TooLarge / NotAPlaylist. Read UTF-8; for .m3u without valid UTF-8, fall back to ISO-8859-1.
    • Skip comments and blank lines.
    • Resolve each entry in order: (1) content:// → match tracks.uri; (2) an absolute path → match tracks.filePath; (3) a relative path → resolve against the playlist's directory, derived from the document id primary:<dir>/x.m3u → /storage/emulated/0/<dir>, then (2); (4) file:// → strip and use (2).
    • Unresolved entries count as missing. .. segments are normalised; resolution never opens arbitrary files, only tracks lookups.
    • Result: replace the queue (with confirm if the queue is not empty) and show LOADED n, MISSING m. (R18)
  • B66 M3U never follows http(s) entries: they count as missing, because there is no network (R30).

docs.title: Themes and shell: R24–R28
docs.text:
• B67 ThemeId → DeckColors palette, one per design card:

    • CLASSIC: charcoal #292D32, phosphor #00FF41, amber #F1C100, steel #363A3D.
    • BENTO: slate #1C2430, amber/gold #F1C100 as primary, aluminium #313538, ice white #EBFFE2.
    • TITANIUM_BLACK: obsidian #0B0F12, gunmetal #313538, signal red #FFB4AB as primary, white #E0E3E7.
    • CYBER_NEON: terminal black #050B07, matrix #00FF66, phosphor #00FF41, emerald #003B14.

    Each palette maps onto the same token names, so components never hard-code colours. Applying a theme writes DataStore, and CanhAmpTheme recomposes immediately. (R24)

  • B68 If "Preserve custom EQ colours" is on, the spectrum and EQ curve keep the CLASSIC green/amber/orange whatever theme is active. (R25)

  • B69 Shell:

    • DeckHeader: app mark, CANH AMP and the screen subtitle, plus the STEREO/MONO LED.
    • Content area.
    • MiniPlayerBar: hidden when the queue is empty; otherwise [mm:ss] ARTIST - TITLE with prev / play-pause / next; tapping the text opens Main.
    • DeckNavBar with 5 tabs: MAIN, EQ, PLAYLIST, LIBRARY, SKINS.

    Navigation Compose keeps state per tab with saveState / restoreState. Back from a non-Main tab returns to Main, and back on Main exits. (R26)

  • B70 Accessibility and fidelity:

    • Every control has a ≥ 48 dp hit area and a contentDescription / stateDescription (for example the shuffle LED: "Shuffle, on").
    • Sliders expose progressSemantics with a value text ("1 kilohertz, plus 3 decibels").
    • Font scaling is supported up to 1.3× without clipping the main deck. Text in VfdText wraps or ellipsizes, and never overlaps.
    • Animations (marquee, LED pulse, bars) respect Settings.Global.ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE == 0 by staying static. (R27)

docs.title: Delivery and security: R28–R30
docs.text:
• B71 CI build.yml fails when:
    • the merged debug manifest contains INTERNET, RECORD_AUDIO or MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS;
    • a case-insensitive grep finds winamp, nullsoft or llama in app/src/main/res, app/src/main/assets or app/src/main/java;
    • a MissingTranslation / ExtraTranslation lint issue exists (copied from the reference repo). (R13, R28, R30)
  • B72 build.yml runs on push to main and on PRs to main, with permissions: contents: read. Steps:
    1. JDK 24.
    2. testDebugUnitTest.
    3. Lint translation check.
    4. B71 checks.
    5. Decode DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64 if present.
    6. assembleDebug with CI_VERSION_CODE=${{ github.run_number }}.
    7. Upload canh-amp-${shortsha}.apk (retention 14 days) and the test reports. (R29, ADR-0004)
  • B73 release.yml is copied from the reference repo with the APK named canh-amp-<version>.apk, the branch main and the version code from the run number. (R29)
  • B74 Strings live in values/strings.xml and values-vi/strings.xml. Deck labels are uppercase per design. They are translated where meaningful (for example LIBRARY / THƯ VIỆN); units (KBPS, KHZ, dB) are not. (R28)
  • B75 Logger logs ids, counts and error classes only, never file names, titles or URIs (personal data, security.md). Release builds log warnings and errors only.
  • B76 Content from files (tags, M3U text, folder names) is untrusted. It is length-capped (tags at 256 chars for display) and rendered as plain text. It is never used to build SQL (Room parameters only) or file paths (B65).

docs.title: Non-Functional
docs.text:
Target Value How it is checked Scan 2,000 MediaStore tracks ≤ 5 s (G2) Timed log (count + ms) and a manual check on the owner's phone Cold start to first frame of Main ≤ 1.5 s, release build (G6) adb shell am start -W on the owner's phone Background playback 60 min with the screen off (G1) Owner manual test, checklist in docs/reports/ DSP CPU < 3% of one core at 48 kHz stereo Microbenchmark-style JVM test: process 60 s of audio in < 1.8 s on a CI runner UI frame time No janky frames while the visualizer runs on Main JankStats logging in debug builds, plus owner observation APK size ≤ 15 MB (debug) CI job summary prints the size Memory Library list paged (50); artwork decoded ≤ 64 dp Code review

Security controls: no network permission (B71); SAF grants are persisted only for imported folders and released on remove (B10); there are no exported components except MainActivity (launcher) and the service's MediaSessionService intent filter; all SQL goes through Room parameters (B7, B76); signing keys exist only in GitHub secrets (ADR-0004).

Observability: Logger with tags Scan, Player, Dsp, M3u and Queue. There is no remote telemetry (R30).

docs.title: Testing
docs.text:
Layer What Behaviours JVM unit (CI) BiquadDesign + EqualizerProcessor: magnitude at each band centre within ±1 dB of the set gain; neighbour bands < 1 dB at 1 kHz; band skip at low sample rates B40–B43 JVM unit Bypass null test (output == input byte-for-byte) B44 JVM unit Limiter: all bands +12 on a 0 dBFS sine, no sample at or above 32767; transparent at −6 dBFS B49, B50 JVM unit BalanceProcessor at −1 / 0 / +1 B30 JVM unit Fft + SpectrumAnalyzer: sine peaks in the right band; silence at the floor B51 JVM unit M3uCodec round trip; EXTINF parsing; relative / absolute / file:// / http; limits; ISO-8859-1 fallback; .. normalisation B64–B66 JVM unit Preset logic: CUSTOM on edit, name validation, built-in collision B46–B48 JVM unit MediaStore row → TrackEntity mapping (fake cursor rows): fallbacks, format, bitrate fallback B3 JVM unit LikeEscaper, duration formatting, marquee text builder B7, B24, B25 JVM unit ViewModels with fake repositories (kotlinx-coroutines-test): timer toggle, queue stats, sort orders, filter B24, B58, B62, B63 Instrumented (manual run, not CI) Room DAOs + migration helper; scan generation delete; queue save/restore B4, B5, B55–B57 Instrumented (manual) Compose UI: nav and back behaviour, mini player toggle, preset selection updates the label B47, B69 Manual on device (owner) Checklist: background 60 min, unplug pause, call interruption, lock-screen controls, Bluetooth buttons, SAF import, M3U in another player B20–B23, B10, B64

The gate for each commit is ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug. sdlc.config.json gets an android component with these gates during the first build task.

docs.title: Rollout
docs.text:
• Branch main. Each push produces a debug APK artifact (com.canhamp.debug) that installs over the previous one (ADR-0004). The owner tests from these.
  • Milestones, as swarm-plan will refine them:
    1. M1 skeleton: CI, theme, shell, nav.
    2. M2 library and playback.
    3. M3 queue and M3U.
    4. M4 DSP and EQ.
    5. M5 visualizer and deck polish.
    6. M6 themes.
    7. M7 release v0.1.0 via release.yml.
  • Database v1 ships in M2. Schema changes after M7 need migrations (ADR-0003).
  • Rollback: install the previous artifact or release APK. If the DB version went up, that needs an uninstall, so schema bumps are avoided between test builds once the owner has data they care about. There are no remote flags.
